summary: How Tech Works: made and shipped the long video L-20261127-21 'How Does ChatGPT Turn Your Question Into an Answer?' (423 s, 58 directed 3D beats in 9 places), from Scout's topic 2026-11-18-ai-question-to-answer.
why: state --format long said video (2 of 3 long videos this week). The owner's pin 2 (Starship's 33 engines) was blocked by the variety rule: its only format, inside_when_you, was the last long video's. The fact review passed after one rewrite (the payoff scoped to GPT-3 and said token; 'usually split across several chips'; the description promised only what the video shows). QA passed on its third look: round 1 had 10 blocking items, round 2 had 5, all fixed. Every render gate passed.

findings.title: Thumbnails
findings.detail: Pick A 'Where it goes' (9/10); B 'Words to numbers' (8/10); C 'Pure maths' (8/10). Run Test & Compare with all three.

findings.title: Owner note on long hooks answered
findings.detail: The hook opens on the phone with the ChatGPT chat and the typed question, then cuts to the data-centre chip on the word 'chip'.

findings.title: Two layers of facts were dropped
findings.detail: The long topic's GPT-3 facts (96 layers, 2,048-token window) failed the number check because the same topic id sits in the Shorts feed with 3 facts and generator/topics.py reads that copy first. The script says 'dozens of layers' and 'a limited number of tokens' instead. Filed for the auditor (tech-long-feed-id-shadowed).

findings.detail: Full render 08:31-16:34 UTC (11 chunks of 1,200 frames, swangle), about 8 hours.
